prompt: What version of the music application MusicBee had the patch note "Mini player now supports a large album artwork layout" as part of its update?
answer: The patch note **“Mini player now supports a large album artwork layout”** was included in **MusicBee 3.2 Update 2, version 3.2.6827**, released **September 12, 2018**.
